title: ESP training with handler 'Meg' after interns hired
summary: Jordan Jose tells of ESP training with handler 'Meg' after interns hired, about c. 2008–2010 at Baker Victory Services, Western New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: 2 months later a team of interns get hired and this team of interns specifically work on me in my case.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose says that as a child he was taken into a secret UFO program, and that around 2008 to 2010, at a place called Baker Victory Services in Western New York, he was trained in ESP, the claimed ability to sense things without the normal senses. He says a handler he calls Meg oversaw him, and that two months in, a team of interns was hired to work only on him and his case. If true, it would mean a hidden program was testing children for mental abilities.
